verdict.rationale: CIPO's own trademarks page publishes a forecasted examination wait time ('approximately: 8.2 months' for filings in October 2026), so it does publish processing times for at least one transaction type. The evidence covers only trademark examination; no published times appear for patents, industrial designs, copyright, renewals or other transactions. Missing for 10: processing times for other transaction types (patents, designs, copyright, renewals, oppositions), evidence of how often the figures are updated, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, current processing times for my transaction type are published by the service itself

citations.quote: If you were to file during the month of October 2026, the forecasted wait time for examination is approximately: 8.2 months
